fields.h1: Build a Risk Assessment Form That Scores Every Hazard
fields.hero_description: Get a risk assessment form anyone can fill in on a phone, with each record saved to a database you own.
fields.features_heading: How a Live Risk Assessment Works
fields.features_subheading: Six ways the assessment keeps working once it is a form instead of a file.
fields.feature_1:
Likelihood times severity, per hazard

Rates each hazard for likelihood and severity on a 1 to 5 scale and multiplies the two. Every row carries a score between 1 and 25, and you decide which score counts as high.
fields.feature_2:
One hazard per screen

Walks the assessor through one hazard at a time on a phone. A supervisor fills it in on the warehouse floor while the hazard is in view, instead of at a desk hours later.
fields.feature_3:
Signed by the assessor

Captures the assessor's e-signature and the date at the end of each assessment and keeps both with the record. The next reviewer sees who scored each hazard, and when.
fields.feature_4:
Alerts that reach one person

Sends a Slack, email, or in-app alert to the person who owns a hazard. Reminders follow until that person acts, and the alert escalates to a second person when nobody does.
fields.feature_5:
Every assessment in a database you own

Saves each assessment as rows in a database you own. Last year's scores sit next to this year's for the same hazard, and there is no cap on the number of responses saved.
fields.feature_6:
Open actions in the tools you use

Connects to any tool with an API, such as a maintenance work order system. An open action from the assessment appears where the work gets assigned, with its owner and due date.

fields.usecase_heading: Who Fills It In, and What Happens Next
fields.tab_content_1:
Any hazard scoring 15 or more alerts the operations manager

Shift supervisors at Tollbrook Cold Storage run the assessment at the start of every shift. Dario Venn rates a blocked fire exit by dock 3 at likelihood 4 and severity 5, a score of 20. Operations manager Mirela Stanton gets a Slack message before the shift ends.
fields.tab_content_2:
Each of 6 actions has a named owner and a due date

The Osprey Ridge Running Club lists 6 actions in the risk assessment for its October 5K. Four are done. Marshal lead Odile Brandt still owns the cones at the river crossing, and an email reminder reaches her 2 days before they are due.
fields.tab_content_3:
Before the first visit, the caregiver reads both yes answers

Hollins Home Care completes a home risk assessment before a caregiver's first visit to a new client. Coordinator Wren Talbot marks yes on 2 of the 8 questions: a large dog and steep front steps. Both answers sit at the top of the visit sheet caregiver Joaquin Reyes opens on his phone.
fields.tab_content_4:
From 40 scanned assessments, 3 need a check by hand

The science department at Kestrel Hill Academy has 40 paper risk assessments for lab practicals. Each scan is read into the same fields as the online form. Three have a value read at low confidence, and lab technician Saul Mendel checks those 3 by hand.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Risk Assessment Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps to create a risk assessment form that scores each hazard and sends high scores to a named owner, then build it with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Walk the work area and list hazards
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Note who could be harmed, and how
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Set a likelihood and severity scale
fields.howto_step_1_des: Walk the work area with the people who do the job, and write down what could cause injury or illness there. HSE's guidance names this as part of the minimum an employer must do under the Management of Health and Safety at Work Regulations 1999.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Next to each hazard, write who could be hurt and in what way: pickers struck by falling stock, or a visitor slipping on a wet floor. Give each group its own line, because the controls for each can differ.
fields.howto_step_3_des: The same HSE minimum asks you to decide how likely it is that someone could be harmed and how seriously. Pick a scale your assessors can apply the same way, and write one example beside each point on it.
fields.howto_step_4_des: HSE's template keeps a record of what you're already doing to control the risks, what further action you need to take, who needs to carry out the action, and when it is needed by. Give each of those its own field.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Paste your hazard list, the scale, and the alert rule into the prompt in plain English. Emergent builds the form and the database its records are saved to. To change a question later, describe the change in a new prompt.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Name one owner for each high score
fields.howto_step_6_des: Decide who hears about a high score at each site, by name rather than through a shared inbox. Choose Slack or email for that person, and name a second person for the alert to escalate to when the first is away.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test it on one hazard you know well
fields.howto_step_7_des: Fill in the form on a phone for a hazard you have already assessed on paper, and score it above your threshold on purpose. Check that the alert reaches the right person and that the record carries the assessor's signature.

faq_plan.q: What is a health and safety risk assessment form?
faq_plan.ref: what is a risk assessment form
faq_plan.a: A health and safety risk assessment form is the written record of a check for workplace hazards. It names what could cause harm and who is exposed to it, how likely and how serious that harm is, and what is being done about it. Each hazard gets its own row, signed and dated by the person who assessed it.

faq_plan.q: How to make a risk assessment form?
faq_plan.ref: how to make a risk assessment form
faq_plan.a: Start by listing the hazards and choosing how you will score them, then decide who must hear about a high score. Describe those three things to Emergent's AI form builder in plain English, and it builds the form along with the database that stores each assessment. Keep the first version to one site and one scoring scale.

faq_plan.q: Where can I find a free template for a risk assessment form?
faq_plan.ref: Where can I find a free template for a risk assessment form?

prov.original: Where can I find a free template for a risk assessment form?

faq_plan.a: The Health and Safety Executive posts a free risk assessment template in Word and OpenDocument formats on hse.gov.uk. HSE also warns against copying an example and just putting a company name on it. Fill the template with the hazards in your own workplace, scored by the people who work there.

faq_plan.q: Who fills out the risk assessment form?
faq_plan.ref: Who fills out the risk assessment form?

prov.original: Who fills out the risk assessment form?

faq_plan.a: Whoever is responsible for the work area should fill it out, such as a supervisor or a site manager, with input from the people who do the task. The form rates the task, not the worker: how a person performs belongs on an employee evaluation form. Forms built on Emergent have no response caps, even with every shift lead submitting one a day.

faq_plan.q: Can you provide an example of a risk assessment form?
faq_plan.ref: Can you provide an example of a risk assessment form?

prov.original: Can you provide an example of a risk assessment form?

faq_plan.a: Yes. A warehouse row might read: hazard, pallets stacked above the aisle; who, pickers struck by falling stock; likelihood 3 and severity 4, a score of 12; action, restack below the line by Friday, owned by the shift lead. HSE's worked examples include a warehouse and factory maintenance work.

faq_plan.q: What is a TB risk assessment form used for?
faq_plan.a: A TB risk assessment form is used to judge a person's risk of tuberculosis and, according to CDC, to help interpret TB test results. CDC counts a health care worker as at increased risk if any statement on its form is marked yes.

faq_plan.q: Who needs a tuberculosis risk assessment form?
faq_plan.a: Every U.S. health care worker should have one at hire: CDC says all U.S. health care personnel should have baseline TB screening, including an individual risk assessment. After that, CDC says personnel without latent TB infection should not undergo routine serial TB screening or testing. CDC does call for annual TB education; a training feedback form shows what staff took in.

faq_plan.q: What should a risk assessment form sample include?
faq_plan.a: A useful risk assessment form sample includes a row per hazard with who could be harmed, the likelihood and severity scores, the controls in place, and the further action, who owns it, and when it is due. It closes with the assessor's signature and the date. Every row lands in a database you own when the form is built on Emergent, ready to set beside next year's assessment.

faq_plan.q: What questions does a health risk assessment form include?
faq_plan.a: A health risk assessment form asks a person about their own health. For the Medicare annual wellness visit, 42 CFR 410.15 lists required topics including demographic data and a self assessment of health status. It also says the assessment collects self-reported information about the beneficiary and takes no more than 20 minutes to complete.

faq_plan.q: What questions are on a dental caries risk assessment form?
faq_plan.a: The ADA's dental caries risk assessment form asks about factors that raise a patient's chance of tooth decay, such as a bottle or sippy cup with anything other than water at bedtime for ages 0 to 6. The ADA publishes one version for patients ages 0-6 and one for patients over 6. At a school dental day, a sign out form records each child returning to class.
